public_rationale: On August 31, 2026, OpenAI reported that tens of thousands of advertisers used ChatGPT Ads [e1]. That disclosure does not establish Google-comparable search-query volume or provide matched SearchGPT and ChatGPT infrastructure and cost-of-revenue figures [e1]. It also does not establish that a large advertising operation was necessary [e1]. The advertising evidence therefore does not settle the conditional forecast [e1].
limitations: The evidence does not establish whether the search-volume condition occurred.
Advertiser counts do not establish the organizational size or economic necessity of the advertising operation.
The evidence supplies no cost comparison with matched workload, service quality and accounting treatment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If run at Google's scale, SearchGPT will be significantly more expensive to run than ChatGPT, both infrastructurally and in cost of revenue, and OpenAI will be forced to create a massive advertising arm that it does not currently have.
conditions: if SearchGPT runs at Google's scale

statement.excerpt: SearchGPT will be significantly more expensive to run at Google's scale than ChatGPT — both infrastructurally and in the cost of revenue, with OpenAI forced to create a massive advertising arm that currently doesn't exist at the company.

from_speaker: SearchGPT will be significantly more expensive to run at Google's scale than ChatGPT
both infrastructurally and in the cost of revenue
OpenAI forced to create a massive advertising arm
currently doesn't exist at the company
our_interpretation: Treat Google's scale as comparable search-query volume, not comparable numbers of registered or weekly active users.
Treat SearchGPT as OpenAI's search product, including its continuation within ChatGPT.
An informative cost comparison must disclose workload volume and service quality; comparing an enlarged search service with a smaller chatbot would otherwise confound scale and product costs.
Significantly means a material cost difference, not a trivial or uncertain one. The speaker supplies no numerical threshold.
Creating an advertising operation is distinct from proving that it was necessary.
criteria.support_condition: After the search product reaches Google-comparable query volume, comparable records establish materially higher infrastructure and cost-of-revenue requirements than ChatGPT, and establish that a large advertising operation was necessary to support it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent occurs, comparable records establish no material increase in either claimed cost category, or sustained operation establishes that the claimed necessary advertising arm was unnecessary.

evidence.explanation: OpenAI had developed substantial advertising operations by this date. Their existence does not show that SearchGPT reached Google's search volume, incurred the predicted comparative costs, or required advertising.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Documented attainment of Google-comparable search-query volume, together with matched operating evidence establishing materially higher costs in both claimed categories and the necessity of a large advertising operation, or evidence at that scale refuting a required component of the forecast.
